description.en: Common transfer configuration.
Specifies whether to enable full data transfer.
Specifies whether to enable full verification.
Specifies whether to enable incremental synchronization.
Whether reverse incremental synchronization is enabled.
Specifies whether to allow structure transfer.
Configuration for full data transfer.

description.zh: 数据迁移或数据同步任务的 ID。您需要调用 ListProjects 接口获取待配置任务的 ID。
description.en: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task. You can obtain the ID of the task to be configured by invoking the ListProjects API.
Configuration for incremental synchronization.

description.zh: 标签 ID 的集合，最多支持 5 个。
description.en: A collection of label IDs. Up to 5 labels are supported.

description.zh: 数据迁移或数据同步任务的名称。
description.en: The name of the data migration or data synchronization task.

description.zh: 通过 GetUploadOssUrl 获取的 Osskey。
description.en: The OssKey obtained by calling GetUploadOssUrl.
Reverse incremental transfer configuration.

description.zh: 目标端数据源的 ID。您需要调用 `ListDataSource` 接口获取 ID，格式为 e_****。
description.en: The DataSource ID of the target endpoint. You can obtain the ID by invoking the `ListDataSource` API. The format is e_****.

description.zh: 源端数据源的 ID。您需要调用 `ListDataSource` 接口获取 ID，格式为 e_****。
description.en: The ID of the source data source. You can obtain the ID by invoking the `ListDataSource` API. The format is e_****.
Configuration for structure transfer.
Mapping information of transfer objects.

description.zh: 任务的类型，包括 `MIGRATION`（表示数据迁移任务）和 `SYNC`（表示数据同步任务）。
description.en: The type of the job, which can be `MIGRATION` (indicating a data migration task) or `SYNC` (indicating a data synchronization task).

description.zh: 是否使用 OSS 方式创建。
description.en: Indicates whether to use OSS for Creation.

description.zh: 传输实例的 ID。您需要调用 ListProjects 接口获取待配置任务的 ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the transmission instance. You must invoke the ListProjects API to obtain the ID of the task to be configured.
